text: Provides documentation for embedding Carta data directly into third-party apps
quote: Learn how to quickly and easily embed Carta data into your app.

text: Sandbox/mock API returns static but valid responses without needing real credentials
quote: It doesn't require genuine credentials and always returns static but valid responses to your requests.

text: Developer portal lets you register and create a playground app to start building integrations
quote: Register for our developer portal and create your playground app to start building.

text: Playground environment closely mirrors the production environment for testing
quote: Our playground environment provides a similar experience to our production environment.

text: Playground apps can be promoted to production directly from the Developer Portal
quote: Promote your playground app to production in the Developer Portal.

text: API authorization uses OAuth 2.0 with support for Authorization Code and Client Credentials grant types
quote: Carta's API uses the OAuth 2.0 open specification to authorize your access to our data, and supports AUTHORIZATION_CODE and CLIENT_CREDENTIALS grant types.

text: Client credentials flow lets an app access company-level data without needing a specific user's permission
quote: The client credentials flow provides access to data about your company and does not require explicit permission from a Carta user prior to accessing that data.

text: OAuth applications can be granted additional scopes to expand what the integration can access
quote: Adding new OAuth scopes to your OAuth application allows you to enhance the capabilities of your integration with the Carta API platform.

text: Pre-built plugins connect to a Carta account to pull fund performance, cap tables, portfolio financials, and partner data
quote: Connect to your Carta account using pre-built plugins and access fund performance, cap tables, portfolio financials, partner data, and more.

text: Natural-language queries retrieve ownership, stakeholders, SAFEs, notes, grants, 409A data, financing history, and comp benchmarks
quote: Access ownership, stakeholder lists, SAFEs, convertible notes, option grants, 409A valuations, financing history, compensation benchmarks, and more — all with natural language questions.

text: A Carta Investors plugin gives LLMs access to fund data to generate tear sheets, budgets, and financial statements
quote: The Carta Investors plugin gives LLMs access to your fund's data and allows you to generate tear sheets, budgets, and financial statements.

text: Incorporation partners and law firms can programmatically send new customers to Carta
quote: Allows incorporation partners and law firms to programmatically send new customers to Carta

text: An API can calculate the tax implications of a user exercising their equity
quote: This API can be used to calculate the tax implications of a user exercising their equity.

text: Documented formulas let developers calculate outstanding and fully diluted ownership percentages via the Cap Table endpoint
quote: The formulas below show how to calculate the following outstanding and fully diluted percentages using our Capitalization Table endpoint

text: An application can be added to an Investment Firm to access its data via the Investor API
quote: The application is now added to your Investment Firm and can be used to access its data via the Investor API

text: A guide explains how to access Carta's APIs using Postman
quote: This guide explains how to access Carta's APIs using Postman.

text: Unifies a firm's fund performance, portfolio financials, and partner capital accounts into a single queryable data source
quote: It unifies your firm's most critical data—from fund performance and portfolio financials to partner capital accounts—into a single, queryable source.

text: API can retrieve an issuer's capitalization table broken down by share class
quote: Retrieve an issuer's capitalization table by share class.

text: API can retrieve stakeholders on an issuer's capitalization table
quote: Retrieve stakeholders. A stakeholder is a person or entity that has been issued a security by an issuer and is, therefore, on the issuer's capitalization table.

text: API can retrieve option grants
quote: Retrieve option grants.

text: API can retrieve convertible notes
quote: Retrieve convertible notes.

text: Draft option grants (not yet finalized or board-approved) are represented as a distinct state, supporting a draft-then-approve workflow
quote: A draft option grant is an option grant that is either still being finalized or that has not yet received board consent and approval.

text: API can retrieve fair market values derived from an issuer's 409A valuations
quote: Retrieve the fair market values of an issuer, which are the values of the issuer's securities as determined by the issuer's 409a valuations.
